### This is a beta release

This build is for testing only. It is published as a pre-release, so it is not offered to
existing installations through the in-app updater — install it by hand from the assets below.

### Coming from the stable release

This line of betas changes how a computer identifies itself, which renames every host once.
Remove each host on both computers and pair them again with the same pairing password. If you
already installed an earlier beta, nothing further is needed.

### Fixes

- A display can be shared before it answers DDC/CI. A display refuses DDC/CI most often because
  it is showing another host, or is asleep — which is the display you came to share. Selecting it
  was therefore withheld from exactly the display being selected, and on Windows the shared
  monitor, busy showing the other computer, could not be selected at all. Its inputs are read
  once it answers; until then it is listed as unavailable.
- A reset shows that it is running. It rewrites the settings file and restarts the agent, so the
  confirmed press is not instant, and it previously showed nothing for that whole time.
- An input note no longer fails for a display that is no longer shared. The note commits when its
  field loses focus, which is also what clicking anything else does, so clicking reset could
  report a failure to save something the user never knowingly saved.

### Known limitations

- Undoing a merge leaves the inputs and notes that merging folded into the display the other
  identity joined.
- Merging and host names only sync between hosts running this version.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may
  require manual approval.

### What to test

- On the computer whose display is currently showing the other one, select that display as
  shared, then switch to it and confirm it works.
- With both computers on this version and paired, confirm each one's port fills itself in after
  the display has been shown on it once.
